product.title: The Blockbuster
product.summary: Build, negotiate and close a franchise-altering trade.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students assemble a trade from players and picks, then negotiate across rounds against an AI counterpart that counters their offers, and must satisfy salary-matching rules before any deal can close.
product.technology: Next.js 16 + React 19 route, with a grade-band toggle

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: A complete multi-stage negotiation state machine with a working grade-band toggle. Not deployed, and no student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: No GitHub Pages deployment (404) and no other live URL found. Requires a build to run.
knownBlockers: No deployment — an instructor cannot run it today without building the app.

publicRelease.previewReason: A focused trade-construction game; among the strongest of the standalone GM sims.

provenance.evidence: BSC-anythingelse/app/blockbuster/page.tsx renders a '5th–6th Grade' and '7th–8th (Hard Mode)' toggle; the landing page lists it at about 15 minutes.
